scope: Read-only catalog metadata only; no user rows or application secrets queried

indexes.name: account_deletion_jobs_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_jobs_pkey ON public.account_deletion_jobs USING btree (id)

indexes.name: account_deletion_jobs_token_hash_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_jobs_token_hash_key ON public.account_deletion_jobs USING btree (token_hash)

indexes.name: account_deletion_jobs_user_id_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX account_deletion_jobs_user_id_idx ON public.account_deletion_jobs USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: account_deletion_jobs_status_expires_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX account_deletion_jobs_status_expires_idx ON public.account_deletion_jobs USING btree (status, expires_at)

indexes.name: account_deletion_jobs_recovery_expires_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX account_deletion_jobs_recovery_expires_idx ON public.account_deletion_jobs USING btree (recovery_expires_at) WHERE (recovery_expires_at IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: user_profiles_email_unique_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_profiles_email_unique_idx ON public.user_profiles USING btree (lower(email)) WHERE ((email IS NOT NULL) AND (identity_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'retired'::text))

indexes.name: user_profiles_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_profiles_pkey ON public.user_profiles USING btree (user_id)

triggers.name: ai_quota_cleanup_retired_account
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER ai_quota_cleanup_retired_account AFTER UPDATE OF identity_status ON public.user_profiles FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.identity_status = 'retired'::text) AND (old.identity_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'retired'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ai_quota_cleanup_retired_account()

triggers.name: sunland_history_cleanup_retired_account
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER sunland_history_cleanup_retired_account AFTER UPDATE OF identity_status ON public.user_profiles FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.identity_status = 'retired'::text) AND (old.identity_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'retired'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION sunland_history_cleanup_retired_account()

triggers.name: trg_user_profiles_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_user_profiles_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

triggers.name: waffo_capture_profile_insert
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER waffo_capture_profile_insert AFTER INSERT ON public.user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION waffo_prod.capture_profile_source()

triggers.name: waffo_capture_profile_update
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER waffo_capture_profile_update AFTER UPDATE OF pro ON public.user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION waffo_prod.capture_profile_source()
